notes.title: Pocket Cars 1.0 Is Officially Here!
notes.content:
Pocket Cars 1.0 has officially launched on Steam!
This milestone marks the end of our Early Access journey and the beginning of a new chapter. Over the years, your feedback and support have been invaluable in shaping Pocket Cars into the thrilling, fast-paced racing game it is today.

[previewyoutube=FgUJbMn38BU;full][/previewyoutube]

What Does 1.0 Mean?
While the 1.0 release doesn’t bring new features, it represents a polished and refined version of the game you’ve come to love during Early Access. It’s the culmination of your feedback and our dedication to delivering a high-quality experience.


Thank You for Being Part of the Journey!
This launch is a huge milestone, but it’s not the finish line. We have exciting plans for future updates and improvements, and your support will continue to drive the development of Pocket Cars.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36217081/9cfa3ef128de8ea74634fa68d587d8e3d8d4ce57.png

Start Racing!
Thank you for joining us on this incredible journey – the best is yet to come! See you at the starting line!


– The Gen90Software Team

notes.title: Pocket Cars 1.0 Launch Date + Roadmap
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce that the Pocket Cars full 1.0 version is coming to Steam on December 11! Throughout Early Access, we received invaluable feedback from you, and we've worked hard to make the game the best it can be.


Behind the Scenes: The Road to Pocket Cars 1.0
During development, we encountered some exciting twists and turns, with many ideas explored—some made it to the final game, while others remain interesting glimpses of what could have been. Here’s a look back at a few original concepts:

[olist]
Charging Mechanics During Races
Originally, cars would have needed recharging mid-race by passing over special charging platforms. If multiple cars were on a platform, the charge would be split, and any car running out of power would be disqualified. We quickly realized this was more frustrating than fun, so the idea was scrapped.

The Original Museum Environment
This was the first Museum environment we created, but it wasn’t well-suited for racing tracks, so we redesigned it from scratch to create a more competitive layout.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36217081/1bec1a032a363028dfab4f9493342838ee3aef18.jpg

Randomized Checkpoint System
Our original plan was for checkpoints to appear in random order, making open tracks essential. However, this turned out to be too challenging for the AI, so we didn’t pursue it. Could this make a comeback as a future online mode? Stay tuned!

Preparing for a Multilingual Release
Initially, we didn’t plan for multiple languages, but player feedback made it clear that this was important to many of you, so we worked to make Pocket Cars enjoyable in as many languages as possible.

Stunt Arena – A Community Idea
The Stunt Arena mode was entirely inspired by the community! It wasn’t on our roadmap at all, but thanks to your feedback, it became a reality and is now a fan favorite.

Multiplayer – Sooner Than Expected
We thought multiplayer might come after the 1.0 release, but with so many requests, we brought it forward and made it a core feature sooner than planned!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36217081/10283000c1e0386ed838b07863a5235c70bdf31d.jpg
[/olist]
Pocket Cars Roadmap: What's Next on the Track!
Here's a look at the Pocket Cars development roadmap! The 1.0 release on december 11 is just the beginning - with exciting new features and updates planned for the future. Fom expanded multiplayer options to a map creator and beyond. we're committed to bringing you fresh content and enhancements.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36217081/9cfa3ef128de8ea74634fa68d587d8e3d8d4ce57.png

Mark your calendars: 2024 December 11!
Thank you for joining us on this exciting journey – and remember, this release is just a milestone! We’ve got plenty more planned for the road ahead. Buckle up, and let’s get ready for the biggest race of the year!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36217081/cdc58805822823d24467df8a005bad269c0a1c17.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36217081/2271810ab298163d235ed1ab4d0fee888ed727e6.png
Only the biggest and baddest vehicles can enter! Take on Monster Madness, a championship where only truck vehicles are allowed to compete. Tackle the most thrilling challenges across specially crafted tracks inspired by Ruins and Forest. Do you have what it takes to come out on top?

notes.title: Info about new updates
notes.content:
Hey gamers!

The last update was a long time ago, but the work didn't stop! We thought we would summarize what contents are under development.


Stability
The latest update to PocketCars (v0.67) included many bug fixes and engine improvements. According to the analytics, there was a large reduction in errors and crashes. We thought this was a good basis to work on bigger improvements.


Customization
One of the biggest feature comes soon. You can customize colors and materials of body, rims, springs, and antenna. Of course, stickers can also be added. The selection may expand later.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36217081/748b6663872de07e2317dbaa6bd1c4da3fafff94.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36217081/c75246c64eff34a01379977c06136311b2f58c60.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36217081/4cd9edec245f305af1209612c3d40fb8663e98d1.png
... and an important question for you:
The Steamworks give an opportunity to share custom content between players. We can expand the game's skin editor with online skin sharing option.
What do you think about this? Write your opinion in the comments section.
(Of course, it only arrives after multiplayer.)


New maps
Two maps are under development. The "Museum" map will be a multi-level building with mostly flat surfaces and the game's first indoor environment. Contra with that, the "Ruins" will be a really off-road and rocky seaside.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36217081/540bfeb54e3b5f0c710ef3fc46996761909244c5.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36217081/093629d0a8fda963f02787fc1c974236aa1fef11.png
The images show the non-final version and the content changes.


Multiplayer
Many have written that multiplayer is very much needed, so we bring it forward. We have already started the first tests. Our public Discord channel will also be launched soon.


Have fun racing!
In the meantime, check out our website and follow us on Twitter and Instagram where we'll post more information.

notes.content:
Star score system
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36217081/7b506735e8f1f8483f2073bf26d5f20be863363c.png
Was it unclear how the game works? Did you get the checkmarks for completing the challenges, and was it a pendant next to your avatar, who understand it?
We have unified all of this to a "star collecting" based score system.

You can customize the complexity of ingame HUD in the options/general menu, so you can even see the current challenges during the race.
Relax! Of course, the checkmarks collected so far have not disappeared, they turned into  stars.


Rewards list
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36217081/cabe4157584d26df3cffb6cf9114253ecebc4ab9.png
You can see your game progress,or next unlock milestones.


Guides
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36217081/f2f8f5d5b533400a0e2120e8fa142ca71505f397.png
You can get more informations about cars, tires and weapons, so this makes it easier for you to decide what you like, what you want to choose. 
These information will appear in the garage and in the weapon-selection menu too.


Visuals
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36217081/eab0a3a769055cc8122488b1399258ab95d96097.png
You will know better the right direction!
We also slightly changed the look of the Checkpoint, similar style as arrows...Matchy-matchy :-) 

The look is not everything, but...we’ve changed the appearance of some weapons.
And yes, there is some resolution-quality update too. 
- New checkpoint design
- EMP's effect visible at knock-outed objects
- Freezer's rocket new design
- Shield design changes
- Rocket texture changes
- Some small fixes at car's shader


Time Attack
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36217081/3edfe065ec7380a715cf1ba2e79384a7f072cf6b.png
Why choose weapon in the trial mode? There is the reason!
We have completely rethought this - sometimes rather boring - circling. 

Now it will be available as Time Attack ---> You can earn bonus seconds by breaking boxes on the race track. The bonus time will deducted from the race time and the current lap time too.
Balance plays a very important role everywhere, sooo we also have to overcome the Time Attack’s challenges. Unfortunately, you have to play some events again. Something for something :-)


Photo Mode
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36217081/c44c4b324ce936d45a6731e711c4cfebf0ff14d1.png
If you like to capture everything, you will be very happy with the photo mode! You can take picture (in the pause menu) of your car during the race, or even of your opponent’s exploded car.
Feel free! Free camera positioning, filter usage for the best photo.
You can find the photos you have in your Steam gallery, which you can share with your friends.


That’s not at all! Next updates will include more environment and car customization,so stay informed! ;-)

notes.title: Update [v0.54]
notes.content:
Improvements

New car: Mythos
New car: Lemans
Locked cars visible in garage as black shadow
Automatic controller change if detect any interaction




Fixes

Crash at quit (Xbox controller)
Pair last used controller at game start (Xbox controller)
Options UI display error at 21:9 aspect monitor
Fix outline shader issue (car wheels at garage)
Mine placement fixes
Other small fixes...




Unlocking Mythos requires 27 challenges from the "PracticeCamp Masters" season.
Unlocking Lemans requires 30 challenges from the "Wild Road Cup" season.

notes.title: Update [v0.53]
notes.content:
The first major update has arrived!

We have prioritized the requested features so that controler support is now available. We hope the new control options will appeal to you.



Improvements

Controller support (Xbox, PS4, Switch, 3rd party)
Keymapping
Bindings display bar in menu
Boost visual increase
Practice season (free-roam mode)
Restart race with same enemies
Season 01 difficulty fixes (easier the 3. and 5. events)
Disable collisions at respawn




Fixes

UI elements at low resolution
Bumper + Cloak cause physical issue
Boost sound sometimes muted




The next update will include vehicle upgrades, so stay informed. :)

notes.title: Update [v0.52]
notes.content:
Improvements

Missed checkpoint warning (HUD + sound)
Time display on HUD at race events (+lap time, +best time)
Next checkpoint arrow on the minimap (if it is too far to see)
Rocket not explode instantly if started next to an enemy
Ambient sounds added




Fixes

Improvements at AI's track line follower
Selection by cursor on UI (only if the cursor moved)
Some part of HUD not updated properly (defaults stuck)

notes.title: Update [v0.51]
notes.content:
Improvements

Smoother camera
"Next" button at event finish (return to the last played season/event)
Displays rewards when you return to the menu
Event restrictions displayed by icons for easier transparency




Fixes

Optimization at vegetation LOD (71% less polygon at some cases)
Control options display bug fixed
Music change bug fixed
Minimap POI sort bug fixed
Some physical bugs fixed (especially at buggies)
Some typo at UI fixed

notes.title: PocketCars Early Access Release
notes.content:
PocketCars is now available as Early Access!

The early access phase and your support give me the opportunity to make this game even better.
We created some discussions at Steam Community page where you can collaborate with us. Feel free to post your suggestions or bug reports.

 Suggestions & Feedbacks
 Bug Reports



Current version and future plans

At first release 93 challenge awaits for you, and it will be expand with bigger updates.
Small fixes are planned about every 1-2 weeks, and bigger feature or content updates monthly.

We hope you have fun.


Thanks for support!
Gen90Software
